name: Slide & Glide
description: Slide & Glide is the premier indoor kids play area in Nagarbhavi, Bangalore (3rd floor, No 125, S N Arcade, above Bakasura Bandi, Annapoorneshwari Nagar). Featuring safe soft play area for kids, toddler play area, trampolines, and kids birthday party packages. Open daily 11:00 AM to 9:00 PM.
